summary: Jin Medical International, a Jiangsu-based orthopedic device maker, furnished a Form -6K reporting completion of the previously disclosed VIE control/master acquisition under the September 8, 2026 Acquisition Agreement. The final step, Changzhou Zhongjin's transfer of its 80% equity interest in Zhongjin Kangma Information Technology (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd., closed October 19, 2026. Because the transfer beat the October 31, 2026 deadline, 622,123 Class A ordinary shares earmarked as substitute consideration will not be issued, and aggregate consideration is unchanged. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium or regulatory clock was disclosed. Watch for post-closing integration and any further VIE consolidation disclosures.
